The '''Binayre Pirate Bunker''' was a stronghold operated by the [[Binayre Pirates]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|There's a bunch of Binayre pirates just around the corner who have a real nice place. If you take them out, anything you find is yours.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="CDAG" />}}
The bunker was originally a camp used by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement forces]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it had become the base of operations of the Binayre Pirates,<ref name="SWG:Ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|A commoner|Talus}}</ref> a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that operated within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].<ref name="CDAG" /> Beyond this base on Talus, the pirates also had headquarters on [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], both in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="CDAG" /> The Binayre Pirate turned the bunker into a stronghold.<ref name="SWG:BPB" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a commoner in the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] provided the coordinates of the Binayre Pirate Bunker to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] brave enough to visit it.<ref name="SWG:Ac" />

The same year, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bronell]] dispatched a spacer to the pirate bunker in order to retrieve information about a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer who owned money to Jabba, as well as to the pirates.<ref name="SWG:B">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Bronell"</ref>
